scope: Two synthetic images at one set of cuts, q, and placement; direct ARM64 native helper capture and public SVG/PDF rasterization. No saved-note, device, or exact pixel parity claim.
candidate: Patch-clamped bilinear interpolation in premultiplied RGBA, floor each fractional coordinate to 4 bits and floor the combined weighted channel result. Coordinates use floating point, not a proven native fixed-point sequence.
rasterizers: resvg 0.45.1 and PyMuPDF 1.28.2 at 96 dpi; alpha-composited over RGB 252
conclusion: Four-bit truncated bilinear approximates these intermediates substantially better, but does not reproduce native pixels. SVG error improves in both controls; PDF effects differ, so no common rendering change is established.
